mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aro_animal_order (sn, area_name, project_name, pi_name, quantity, male_quantity, female_quantity, order_state, create_time, arrival_date) VALUES (#{sn}, #{areaName}, #{projectName}, #{piName}, #{quantity}, #{maleQuantity}, #{femaleQuantity}, #{orderState}, #{createTime}, #{arrivalDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE area_name = VALUES(area_name), project_name = VALUES(project_name), pi_name = VALUES(pi_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), male_quantity = VALUES(male_quantity), female_quantity = VALUES(female_quantity), order_state = VALUES(order_state), create_time = VALUES(create_time), arrival_date = VALUES(arrival_date)

INSERT INTO aro_animal_order ( item_id, sn, area_name, project_name, pi_name, create_time, arrival_date, supplier_name, strain_name, spec_name, male_qty, female_qty, collector_name, collector_tel, order_state_name, consume_location, memo ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{sn}, #{areaName}, #{projectName}, #{piName}, #{createTime}, #{arrivalDate}, #{supplierName}, #{strainName}, #{specName}, #{maleQty}, #{femaleQty}, #{collectorName}, #{collectorTel}, #{orderStateName}, #{consumeLocation}, #{memo} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sn = VALUES(sn), area_name = VALUES(area_name), project_name = VALUES(project_name), pi_name = VALUES(pi_name), create_time = VALUES(create_time), arrival_date = VALUES(arrival_date), supplier_name = VALUES(supplier_name), strain_name = VALUES(strain_name), spec_name = VALUES(spec_name), male_qty = VALUES(male_qty), female_qty = VALUES(female_qty), collector_name = VALUES(collector_name), collector_tel = VALUES(collector_tel), order_state_name = VALUES(order_state_name), consume_location = VALUES(consume_location), memo = VALUES(memo)
mapper.select: SELECT project_name AS projectName, SUM(male_qty + female_qty) AS totalQty, SUM(male_qty) AS maleQty, SUM(female_qty) AS femaleQty, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN (male_qty + female_qty) ELSE 0 END) AS monthQty, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{weekStart} THEN (male_qty + female_qty) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{lastWeekStart} AND create_time < #{weekStart} THEN (male_qty + female_qty) ELSE 0 END) AS weekQty FROM aro_animal_order WHERE project_name = #{projectName} AND pi_name = #{piName}

SELECT log.id AS logId, log.user_id AS userId, log.name AS userName, log.project_group_names AS groupName, log.area_name AS areaName, log.room_name AS roomName, log.room_id AS roomId, log.create_time AS enterTime, ai.median_duration_mins AS aiDurationMins, ai.overtime_prob AS aiOvertimeProb, log.is_shared_card, log.is_keep_card, log.is_borrowed_card, CASE WHEN m.aro_user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_physical_card_mapping, CASE WHEN m.aro_user_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(log.is_borrowed_card, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_own_card, COALESCE(m.freeze_exempt_flag, 0) AS freeze_exempt_flag FROM aro_access_log log LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m_inner.aro_user_id, MAX(COALESCE(m_inner.freeze_exempt_flag, 0)) AS freeze_exempt_flag FROM twin_card_mapping m_inner GROUP BY m_inner.aro_user_id ) m ON m.aro_user_id = log.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ai_inner.user_id, ai_inner.room_id, MAX(ai_inner.median_duration_mins) AS median_duration_mins, MAX(ai_inner.overtime_prob) AS overtime_prob FROM aro_behavior_prediction ai_inner WHERE ai_inner.day_type = 'ALL_DAYS' GROUP BY ai_inner.user_id, ai_inner.room_id ) ai ON ai.user_id = log.user_id AND ai.room_id = log.room_id WHERE log.accessType = 1 AND CAST(log.create_time AS DATETIME) >= CAST(#{todayStart} AS DATETIME) AND CAST(log.create_time AS DATETIME) < CAST(#{todayEnd} AS DATETIME) AND log.area_name LIKE #{areaPattern} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aro_access_log out_log WHERE out_log.user_id = log.user_id AND out_log.room_id = log.room_id AND out_log.accessType IN (2, 3) AND CAST(out_log.create_time AS DATETIME) > CAST(log.create_time AS DATETIME) AND CAST(out_log.create_time AS DATETIME) >= CAST(#{todayStart} AS DATETIME) AND CAST(out_log.create_time AS DATETIME) < CAST(#{todayEnd} AS DATETIME) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM twin_dahua_activation_state das WHERE das.user_id = log.user_id AND das.state = 'AUTO_EXIT_SCHEDULED' AND das.scheduled_exit_at > NOW() ) ORDER BY log.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
